beats.say: Doctors still put blood-sucking leeches on people. On purpose.
The medicinal leech. A slimy worm with a sucker at each end.
Its mouth has three tiny jaws, lined with teeth.
The bite leaves a scar shaped like a three-pointed star.
Its spit numbs you, so you might not even feel it.
Then it drinks up to eight times its own weight in blood.
Subscribe. Next, a frog you can see straight through.
